content.text: {"grade": 5, "complete": false, "main_gap": "Lemma 4's key step — existence of a signed subset of original pieces with |Ξ| ≤ Σε_i + [M odd]a_M via a tree component of the pair-multigraph — is asserted as 'standard; details omitted', not proved.", "errors": [{"description": "The heart of the lower bound is omitted. The write-up must show the pair-multigraph (n+1 vertices, ≤n edges) has an acyclic loop-free component, 2-colour it, and check that each pair inside it contributes ±ε_i and the unpaired part ±a_M. None of this (the edge-count argument, the bipartite signing, the handling of loops/cycles) is written; only the conclusion is stated.", "quote": "By a tree-component argument on the multigraph whose vertices are the original pieces $0,1,\\dots,n$ and whose edges are the pairs $P_i$, there is a set $V_T\\subseteq\\{0,\\dots,n\\}$ and signs $s:V_T\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$ such that the signed sum $\\Xi:=\\sum_{j\\in V_T}s(j)\\,q_j$ satisfies $|\\Xi|\\le\\sum_i\\varepsilon_i+[M\\text{ odd}]\\,a_M$ (standard; details omitted)."}], "notes": "Correct answer. Lemma 2 (picking-phase value) and Lemma 5 (subset-sum pigeonhole + cross-pairing cuts, mark count ≤ n, grid coincidence) are fully and correctly argued. Lemma 1 and (3.1) fine. The omitted tree-component step is short and repairable but is the crux of the lower bound, so not full marks. Numerical checks earn nothing."}
